brief:
Israeli naval forces detained four fishermen operating in waters off Gaza City, the Ma'an news agency reported. The detentions took place during operations in the territory's coastal zone, where Palestinian fishing vessels regularly conduct their work despite ongoing maritime restrictions.

The circumstances surrounding the apprehension remain unclear. Israeli naval blockade policies have long limited Palestinian fishing access, with vessels frequently subject to interception in disputed waters and fishermen occasionally detained during such encounters.
title: Israeli Navy Detains Four Fishermen Off Gaza City
